subject.title: Feature request: configurable announce/connection timeout for gateway

question: Should stalled gateway lifecycle work be governed by new gateway-level timeout config, or should announce, channel connection, and plugin startup keep separate owner-specific timeout contracts?
rationale: The requested fix adds public config and failure semantics across multiple owners, and current policy treats config/default additions and lifecycle fallback behavior as maintainer product decisions.

options.title: Choose one gateway lifecycle policy
options.body: Define a single public policy that names which phases are bounded, how failures log/return, and which restarts are triggered before accepting implementation work.

options.title: Keep owner-specific timeout surfaces
options.body: Handle A2A announce, subagent announce, channel health, provider connects, and plugin startup with narrower existing or new owner-specific knobs instead of adding broad gateway fields.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Ask for redacted logs or Crabbox/live proof of the stalled phase before deciding which timeout owner should change.

recommendation.title: Choose one gateway lifecycle policy
recommendation.body: Define a single public policy that names which phases are bounded, how failures log/return, and which restarts are triggered before accepting implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest current-history owner across the sessions_send, gateway schema, channel startup, and plugin bootstrap surfaces that the policy would need to coordinate.
